cond_0009.intro:
We are looking for a CMM Operator / Quality Technician to join our team.
This role supports quality operations across divisional areas to help ensure production lines consistently meet customer quality and delivery requirements. Responsibilities include working with others on measuring process performance, investigation, and reporting in support of manufacturing operations.
cond_0009.responsibilities:
Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.
Develop and create CMM Programs in coordination with quality and engineering teams.
Work with production and quality leaders to help ensure product meets company standards.
Coordinate with production and quality leaders on a variety of quality issues.
Support investigation and corrective actions related to vendor opportunities.
Document and report nonconformance reports in collaboration with relevant teams.
Work with engineering to provide appropriate blueprint change requests.
Complete and submit organizational paperwork including days off requests, team member evaluations, corrective actions, and various reports and checklists.
Help ensure compliance with all divisional safety policies and procedures.
cond_0009.requirements:
Minimum Requirements:
CMM Programming experience using PCDMIS
Proficiency in GD&T
Ability to read and interpret blueprints, material specifications, frame prints, measurements, schedules, and part prints
Understanding of capability studies
Familiarity with measurement equipment including calipers, tape measures, gages, micrometers, and height gages
Ability to perform root cause analysis and containment processes
Ability to perform and evaluate results of various types of testing and document inspection and/or test results
Strong problem-solving and critical thinking skills
Ability to add, subtract, multiply, divide, and convert in all units of measure using whole numbers, common fractions, and decimals
Clear verbal and written communication skills (English)
Working knowledge of Microsoft Office applications
Must be legally authorized to work in [Location masked]
Preferred Requirements:
Advanced education or college degree
Previous quality management experience
Proven quality assurance and auditing experience in a similar industry
Basic knowledge of inventory and manufacturing software; D365 and understanding of Mobile Device and scanner
Leadership experience
Strong attention to detail, organization, and time management skills
